name: gotthard
description: Swiss-sovereign open-source agentic desktop for SMEs – MVP engine layer and CLI

scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{require('child_process').execSync('uv --version',{stdio:'ignore'});require('child_process').execSync('uv sync --frozen --project packages/gotthard-mcp',{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){console.warn('[gotthard] uv not found – install uv, then run: npm run setup:python')}"
scripts.build:templates: uv run --frozen --project packages/gotthard-mcp python scripts/build_assets.py templates
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:node
